title: Haye Fizza
body:
haye fizza haye haye fizza
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ki betiyon ko yun bachayegi fizza
ke unke hisse ke patthar bhi khayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
lipat ke royegi zainab se karbala ki hawa
rida jo khaake shifa ke udhayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
karegi yaad zamana ali ki shahi ka
aseer hoke jo kufe mein jayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
khule saron ko bohat yaad aayega ghazi
qabeele waalon ko jis dam bulayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
karegi qaid mein yun ehteram zainab ka
qadam ki khaak ko sar par uthayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
sarhane baithi hui turbate sakina par
na hogi shamma to aansu jalayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
mili lehed bhi bohat paas shaahzadi ke
na chod kar kahin zainab ko jayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan jahan pe bhi zainab ka tazkera hoga
wahan wahan safe matam bichayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
khade hai marqad e fizza pe aamir o nayyar
inhe bhi lehja e quran sikhayegi fizza
ali ki betiyon ko...
author: Nayyar Jalalpuri
